dialogue.user: *clears throat* Hello, I'm in the market for a new pair of shoes. Quality is important to me, so I want shoes with at least a 4-star average rating. Reviews don't matter much, but I'd like to hear more about the options you have available that match what I'm looking for. Can you tell me about any shoes in your inventory that might fit the bill?
